def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Grid separators are full rows/columns in the frame color.
    candidates = [v for v in set(x for row in grid for x in row) if any(all(x == v for x in row) for row in grid) and any(all(grid[r][c] == v for r in range(h)) for c in range(w))]
    sep_color = candidates[0]
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == sep_color for v in row)]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep_color for r in range(h))]
    r_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    c_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    rb = [(r_bounds[i]+1, r_bounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(r_bounds)-1)]
    cb = [(c_bounds[i]+1, c_bounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(c_bounds)-1)]
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row if v != sep_color), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    blocks = [[ [grid[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1)] for r in range(r0,r1)] for r0,r1 in rb for c0,c1 in cb]
    # Choose the tile with the most non-background cells, then repeat it.
    best = max(blocks, key=lambda b: sum(v != bg for row in b for v in row))
    return [[sep_color if r in sep_rows or c in sep_cols else best[(r - sum(x < r for x in sep_rows)) % len(best)][(c - sum(x < c for x in sep_cols)) % len(best[0])] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
